name: nlpm
description: Natural-Language Programming Manager for Codex — discover, score, check, fix, test, trend, security-scan, and report on AI instruction artifacts, backed by the 50 Rules, a 100-point rubric, cross-tool conventions, vocabulary discipline, and a deterministic validator.

interface.shortDescription: Full NL artifact quality workflows and reference knowledge for Codex.
interface.longDescription: NLPM's complete Codex workflow suite: initialize a project, inventory NL artifacts, score them on a 100-point rubric, check cross-artifact consistency, apply safe fixes, track trends, run NL-TDD specs, scan executable plugin surfaces, render local HTML reports, manage vocabulary discipline, and refresh tool-spec overlays. The plugin also includes the 50 Rules of Natural Language Programming, per-tool conventions for Claude Code / Codex / Antigravity, authoring guides, lifecycle reminders, and the standalone bin/nlpm-check deterministic validator.
defaultPrompt: Use NLPM to inventory and score this repository's AI instruction artifacts.
Run an NLPM consistency check on this plugin.
Security-scan this plugin before I install it.
